gen-dafont-starborn-gf-saira: Starborn drifts across the line with dreamy, widely spaced letters. Saira's plain sans body has see-through s shapes and rounded letters reaching tall, which gives those gaps something steady to lean on.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-savate: Dreamy and spaced out: Starborn floats above the page. Savate's sans-serif body, with sturdy hairlines and open jaws on every curve, is what keeps all that drifting grounded.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sen: Dreamy Starborn stretches its letters far apart, while Sen holds a tall, constant-weight line with curves that stop before turning inward. Below it, the sans body stays modern and uniform in stroke.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as capitals. Starborn's wide gaps and thick dark lowercase stripe would get lost if the heading were made small.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-sono: Starborn spaces its letters wide and dreamy, with a dark lowercase band. Sono's sans body, tall in the lowercase with open-mouthed a shapes, can be set at a modest size without losing its friendly manner.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch has curves you can see right into and rod-like lines of identical thickness throughout every lowercase word. Beside Starborn, paragraphs would move along in a gentle monotone.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-ubuntu-sans: Dark and dreamy: Starborn drifts above Ubuntu Sans, whose lowercase has big washer-like eyes and tubular, pipe-bent strokes. Text in it moves along smoothly, with no swelling in the bowls.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws ruler-straight lines of constant width. Starborn does its best work as a dreamy, widely spaced showpiece, while the sans-serif body does its best simply carrying text with open curves.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase that rivals its capitals. Stencilia, structural and striking with spacious curve gaps, earns its keep when set big and short, where the sans-serif body can stay quiet.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-anek-tamil: Stencilia is structural and striking, with spacious gaps at its curve terminals and a compact gap below the ascender line. Anek Tamil's big round lowercase bowls are the softer, modern counterpoint.
